description: The least this window needs: read its own state, listen for its own events, and call the suite's own commands. `core:webview:allow-set-webview-zoom` because the content context menu offers Zoom In, Zoom Out and Reset Zoom; `core:window:allow-start-dragging` because the custom title bar is a `data-tauri-drag-region` and Tauri denies that call without this permission even though `core:window:default` is granted; `opener:allow-reveal-item-in-dir` because Preferences reveals the app's own config file in the system file explorer rather than opening a settings window that does not exist yet. No `core:tray:*` permission is granted — this template has no tray icon of its own to show yet, and no filesystem, shell, network, or process permission is granted at all. Every permission here is justified by a specific feature (.agents/rules/08-tauri-and-security.md).
